r_company_deposit_gates.subject: deposit_gates_scheduling
r_company_deposit_gates.content: A job is never scheduled until its contract is signed and its deposit has cleared.
r_company_deposit_gates.notes: Observed on the Fairground contract ($12k deposit gating scheduling). Confirm this is universal.

r_company_building_permit.subject: building_permit
r_company_building_permit.content: Every structural or addition job carries a building permit; permit coordination is the contractor's responsibility.
r_company_building_permit.notes: TODO(Will): confirm whether small interior-only remodels ever run permit-free.

r_company_weather_window.subject: weather_windows
r_company_weather_window.content: Foundation pours, exterior flatwork, and roof framing are not scheduled between mid-December and mid-February without explicit approval.
r_company_weather_window.notes: TODO(Will): exact dates and what cold-weather measures unlock an exception.

r_company_rock_excluded.subject: rock_excavation
r_company_rock_excluded.content: Rock excavation is always excluded from base scope; encountering rock becomes a change order, never absorbed.

r_company_local_pricing.subject: allowance_pricing
r_company_local_pricing.content: Allowance pricing from national-average retail data must be confirmed against local Tri-Cities supplier pricing before any order is placed.
r_company_local_pricing.notes: Stated verbatim in TCR's own take-off documents.
